text: Epilogue debrief 'Back where you started.' appears ~3.5 game-s after re-entering the hall via the Screen door. Clear and fitting text. Caption also shown.

The 'THE LAST LOOP / "I" is a strange loop' plaque sits on the passage's west wall, side-on to the walking direction. Readable only if you stop and turn to face it; on my first pass (holding w ~2.5s from hall centre as the 'keep walking straight ahead' sign says) I was looped back to the hall without ever seeing it. Passage is short, so the payoff text is easy to miss.

Small dark specks float in the hall: a row of ~6 dots near the ceiling right of the far door, and a row of ~4 on the floor in front of the passage (facing north from z~3.9). Look like stray geometry/z-fighting. Also visible in other hall shots.

After the epilogue the hall is consistent: Screen door south still leads to the purple Screen room, progress plaque now reads '6 of 6 rooms solved / And the hall itself is a loop. Thank you for playing.', objective 'Every loop found, the hall's too. Wander as you like.' The north sign still says 'The way out / Go through, and keep walking straight ahead.' even though it is now known not to be one (arguably the joke).
